title: COSHUMA affiliate application batch from audited priority list

payload.goal: After the full affiliate audit finishes, begin applying to the highest-priority free affiliate programs that can be completed without human-only verification.
requirements: Use the completed Princess audit result as the source of truth for candidate priority and official application links.
Skip already approved, already pending, rejected-with-cooldown, closed, paid-to-join, or clearly duplicate programs.

Apply automatically only where signup/application is free and no CAPTCHA, payment approval, legal-signature acknowledgement beyond ordinary account terms, OTP, or forced human verification blocks progress.

Use existing COSHUMA business identity/profile information already available in the browser/account context; do not ask the user for data that is already known or retrievable from existing connected accounts.
For each program, record submitted/pending/approved/blocked status, official application URL, network/provider, next expected event, and whether a unique tracking link is issued.
If a tracking link is issued, verify it is unique/referral-bearing before marking approved_tracking and return it for repo integration.
Do not spend money or start any paid subscription.
